intent.input: 我想看看照相馆后面封着的暗房，找找有没有值得保存的老街影像。

content.title: 暗房里的老街印象
content.discovery: 通过放大这张老照片，你发现街道两侧的建筑风格细节，透露出上世纪中叶的生活节奏与社区氛围，仿佛时光静止在这里。
content.photograph: A clear old street scene showing a continuous row of traditional mid-20th century buildings with tiled roofs and wooden window frames. The street is empty and clean, edged by narrow sidewalks and occasional street lamps. The architecture features modest, two-story structures with faded paint and small balconies. The image is composed so that the left and right halves align perfectly to form a continuous, uninterrupted view of the street, emphasizing the quiet, abandoned atmosphere.
content.arrival: 小灯照着旧工作台，门仍通向照相馆。
content.observation: 显影盘里的影像还没有清晰，可以先在房间里看看。

media.description: An empty worn photographic darkroom surface, orthographic overhead, subdued warm lighting. No doors, furniture, people or objects; these remain independent.
